version: LOCK 57 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: A boy drowning in the canal
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: A boy drowning in the canal
missions.kicker: River Market · A boy drowning in the canal
missions.button: Someone is shouting at the canal

a.text: Ali, one of the quay boys, has slipped off the steps into the canal. He can't swim and the current is pulling him toward the boats.

choices.label: Throw a rope from the boats

jump.text: The water is cold and fast. You get an arm round Ali and kick for the steps, where Jamal hauls you both out. Ali coughs up half the canal and then starts to cry.

rope.text: Your first throw misses. The second lands across his arms and he holds on. You pull him in hand over hand.

shout.text: Jamal dives in from his boat and brings Ali out.

saved: Pulled Ali out of the canal
